name: Sacred Ecological Living Archive Dossier
zip_source: more styles.zip / Sacred Ecological Living Archive Dossier (4 curated inspiration refs)
composition: Vertical parchment/orange page; top archive header; central living totem 45-60%; side note cards; bottom taxonomy strip; vines, birds, stamps in margins.
prompt_core: Create a vertical Kibookal Living Archive Dossier page on warm cream (or vivid orange) paper. At the centre place [SUBJECT] as a dignified living totem being decoded - emotionally intelligent, hand-inked, surrounded by an alive archive of blank field cards, specimen boxes, ritual tools, ecological tokens, vines, birds, insects, red-thread paths and a sacred stabilising halo. Use dark brown-black contours, dense controlled internal hatching, flat spot colours in kumkum red, saffron, turmeric, neem green, peacock teal, lotus pink and ochre gold. Keep face, eyes, hands and silhouette very clear. The page should feel discovered by a child-investigator inside an ancient-future Indian civilisation.
negative: no glossy fantasy, no corporate infographic, no photoreal skin, no modern UI, no exact reference copy, no clutter over face, no generated body text unless text_mode demands it
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
